# Exercise 2
```{r}
n = 100
epsilons = rnorm(n, 0, 1)

MA1 = function(theta, epsilons){
  Yts = c(epsilons[1])
  n = length(epsilons)
  for(i in 2:n){
    Yts[i] = -theta * epsilons[i-1] + epsilons[i]
  }
  Yts
}
P1 = MA1(0.9, epsilons)
P2 = MA1(-0.9, epsilons)

plot(P1, type="l", xlab="Time", ylab="P1")
lines(P2, col="red")
legend("topright", legend=c("theta = 0.9", "theta=-0.9"), col=c("black", "red"), lty=1)
```

```{r}
MA2 = function(theta, epsilons){
  Yts = c(epsilons[1], epsilons[2])
  n = length(epsilons)
  for(i in 3:n){
    Yts[i] = -theta[1] * epsilons[i-1] - theta[2] * epsilons[i-2] + epsilons[i]
  }
  Yts
}
P = MA2(c(0.5, -0.5), epsilons)
plot(P, type="l", xlab="Time", ylab="P")
```
# Exercise 3

```{r}
AR1 = function(phi, epsilons){
  Yts = c(epsilons[1])
  n = length(epsilons)
  for(i in 2:n){
    Yts[i] = phi * Yts[i-1] + epsilons[i]
  }
  Yts
}
PAR1 = AR1(0.9, epsilons)
PAR2 = AR1(0.4, epsilons)
PAR3 = AR1(-0.8, epsilons)
PAR4 = AR1(-0.5, epsilons)
plot(PAR1, type="l", col="blue", xlab="Time", ylab="AR(1) series")
lines(PAR2, col="red")
lines(PAR3, col="green")
lines(PAR4, col="purple")
legend("topright", legend=c("phi=0.9","phi=0.4","phi=-0.8","phi=-0.5"),
       col=c("blue","red","green","purple"), lty=1)
```

```{r}
acf(PAR1, main="Autocorrélation de PAR1, phi=0.9")
acf(PAR2, main="Autocorrélation de PAR2, phi=0.4")
acf(PAR3, main="Autocorrélation de PAR3, phi=-0.8")
acf(PAR4, main="Autocorrélation de PAR4, phi=-0.5")
```
```{r}
AR2 = function(phi, epsilons){
  Yts = c(epsilons[1])
  n = length(epsilons)
  for(i in 2:n){
    if(i == 2){
      Yts[i] = phi[1] * Yts[i-1] + epsilons[i]
    }
    else{
      Yts[i] = phi[1] * Yts[i-1] + phi[2] * Yts[i-2] + epsilons[i]
    }
  }
  Yts
}
PAR1 = AR2(c(0.5, 0.25), epsilons)
PAR2 = AR2(c(1, -0.25), epsilons)
PAR3 = AR2(c(1.5, -0.75), epsilons)
PAR4 = AR2(c(1, -0.6), epsilons)
plot(PAR1, type="l", col="blue", xlab="Time", ylab="AR(1) series")
lines(PAR2, col="red")
lines(PAR3, col="green")
lines(PAR4, col="purple")
legend("topright", legend=c("phi=0.9","phi=0.4","phi=-0.8","phi=-0.5"),
       col=c("blue","red","green","purple"), lty=1)
```
